items.title: Eli Lilly (LLY) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher As Analysts Back GLP 1 Growth
items.summary: Eli Lilly’s updated fair value estimate has shifted from US$1,297.31 to US$1,325.39, adding a fresh data point to an already closely watched price target range. This move sits alongside analyst price targets that often sit above US$900, with a cluster between US$1,300 and US$1,600, as research teams debate how much of the GLP-1 and obesity story is already reflected in the stock.
